data.status: first location is expected to launch next year
data.short_description: San Diego birria chain Mike's Red Tacos signed a deal with franchisee Built Different Brands to bring 36 restaurants to the Orlando and Tampa markets. The first location is expected to launch next year. More than 350 units are committed nationwide.

data.footage_size: 1,400 square feet (new Williamsburg space); 700 square feet (existing Greenpoint and West Village locations)
data.short_description: Michelin Guide-recognized Taqueria El Chato will open its largest location yet at 347 Bedford Ave. at S. 4th St. in Williamsburg. The space will have two kitchens and a center island, and it will seat three to four times as many people as the other stores.
Taqueria El Chato has another location in the works in Park Slope near Seventh Ave. The team is currently finalizing the space, which will feature the brand's more refined design.

Udon restaurant Yume Ga Arukara opened its first NYC location at 271 Fifth Avenue in NoMad on October 21. This expands the Cambridge, Massachusetts-born concept, which Bon Appétit ranked on its 2018 "Hot 10" list.

data.location: 143 Allen Toussaint Blvd, New Orleans, LA 70124
data.short_description: A new Makeup by Meggan location will open on Nov. 6 in Lakeview. Like the Canal Place location, it will be a retail cosmetics store that also offers professional makeup application services.

data.location: 1217 Del Prado Blvd S, Cape Coral, FL 33990
data.short_description: Castaways Sports Grill, a full-service restaurant and bar with TVs and live entertainment, is preparing to open in Cape Coral. Plan review paperwork was recently submitted, and the opening timeline is unknown.

Fiorella Italian Kitchen & Pizzeria, operated by Fireman Hospitality Group, will serve its final meal on October 29. The waterfront restaurant is known for thin-crust pizzas and views of the Potomac River.

data.status: will permanently close after service on October 28
data.short_description: Café Fiorello DC, which opened in 2025 as an offshoot of the Upper West Side landmark, will permanently close after service on October 28. Its OpenTable reservation page also confirmed the closure.

data.short_description: Alimento LLC submitted plan review documents for a new Alimento at 808 S Dale Mabry Highway. The family-owned meal prep brand currently operates inside the Jeep dealership at 2966 N Dale Mabry Highway.

Austin-based Zeds Real Fruit Ice Cream is preparing to open its first San Antonio location at The Collection shopping center in Alamo Heights. Work is scheduled to begin in December, and no official opening date has been announced.

data.short_description: Milk & Maple Coffeehouse, a certified kosher café inside Chabad Intown on the Atlanta Beltline, opens November 1. The grand opening will include a ribbon-cutting, free coffee and family entertainment.
West Nashville sushi restaurant and izakaya Punk Wok, in the Sylvan Supply development, will close October 25. The team announced the closure on social media.
51 North Taproom in The Nations will close December 13 after 10 years. The owners said the past year made operations unsustainable.

data.short_description: Somerville sustainable goods shop and refillery Green Tiger & Co. is preparing to open a second storefront near Inman Square in spring 2027. The location is part of the Cambridge Redevelopment Authority's Neighbor Storefronts Project.

Moo Moo Express Car Wash opened its 40th Central Ohio location in northeast Columbus. Parent company Express Wash Concepts operates 150 car washes and plans to open 30 new locations annually over the next five years.

data.short_description: Trader Joe's will open its first Anaheim Hills store at Santa Ana Canyon Road and Fairmont Road on October 22, 2026. The store hired more than forty new Crew Members and will be open 9 am – 9 pm daily.

data.location: 1923 St Charles Ave, New Orleans, LA 70130
data.short_description: The Warbler Hotel opens on St. Charles Avenue in the Garden District on the former Trolley Stop Cafe site. The six-story hotel has 58 guestrooms, destination dining and a rooftop social space, and it is the first hospitality project from developer Verdad.

data.event_date: Not specified (team hopes to open before Christmas 2026)
data.short_description: Nellie Rose Restaurants is launching Cranky Frankie's Bagel Co. in the former East Grove Laundromat site across from Middleborough High School. Signage is up, and the bagels will be boiled and baked. No official opening date has been announced.

data.event_date: Not specified (owner hopes to open by November)
data.short_description: Tin & Pig plans to open in the former Baegopa space in Seattle's Chinatown–International District. An exact opening date has not been set, but owner So Choi hopes to open by November.
The original Tin & Pig opened in Oakland's Temescal neighborhood in mid-2016. It was later handed to a new owner, who recently closed the business.

data.location: 600 S La Brea Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90036
data.short_description: A new restaurant is planned for 600-606 S. La Brea Ave., where the property owner received approval for full alcohol service. The approved plan allows up to 135 indoor and 108 outdoor seats.

data.location: 600 S La Brea Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90036
data.short_description: The space at 600 S. La Brea was previously home to 6th & La Brea Brewery & Restaurant, a brewpub and sports bar. According to Yelp, it has since closed.
The article references LOQUI's sixth location at 176 S. La Brea Ave. among openings previously covered on the corridor. No further details are given.
The article references Leopardo at the former La Brea Bakery flagship among openings previously covered on the corridor. No further details are given.
A filing and a pinned Facebook post indicate SuKarne may be preparing to reopen its Vista meat market, which Yelp and MapQuest list as permanently closed. No reopening date has been announced.

data.status: would take over the former Coco's Bakery
data.short_description: What Now San Diego previously reported that Black Bear Diner would take over the former Coco's Bakery at 605 W. Vista Way. No further details are given.

data.location: 1022 W El Norte Pkwy, Escondido, CA 92026, USA
data.short_description: Vietnamese café BewBew Home Cafe, operating under parent brand Oh My Pate, plans its second North County location in Escondido. The owner said the team is in the final stages of preparation ahead of a January 2027 grand opening.
The article references a previously covered third location of Batch & Box in San Marcos. No further details are given.

data.status: planning to open its third location
data.short_description: Halal Eatz plans its third location in the Route 30 Mall next to NY Bagel Factory and received approval to operate until 2 a.m. daily. The location is expected to be the chain's larger flagship, incorporating part of the former Boston Market space, with 55 seats.

data.event_date: November or December of this year (before the end of 2026)
data.status: will be making its debut on K Street before the end of 2026
data.short_description: PLNT Cafe, a new sibling concept to PLNT Burger, will open in the former Shouk space with seating for up to 26 guests. The menu will expand beyond burgers to include tacos, salads and wraps, and the concept will not serve coffee. No opening date is set, but the team plans to be customer-ready in November or December.

A permit filed with the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation shows a new Church's Chicken planned for a standalone lot formerly home to a CEFCO and an older Church's Chicken. Construction of the estimated $500,000 project is planned to start at the beginning of 2027 and wrap up by the end of July. Franchisee Best American Hospitality Corp. (BAH Texas, LP), owned by David Davoudpour, is behind the opening.

Owner Hamza Malhees is working on opening ChefMan Mediterranean Bowls at the corner of Blatt Boulevard, next to Winnie's cafe. The concept will offer customizable bowls with shawarma, proteins, toppings and sauces. Malhees said he does not yet have an opening date.

data.location: 80 N High St #72, Columbus, OH 43215, USA
data.short_description: Rosalita, a modern Mexican restaurant from chef Josh Dalton, is planned for 72–80 N. High St. inside the historic Madison and White-Haines buildings. The restaurant was previously expected to open in 2025, but its timeline shifted. Original plans called for about 60 indoor seats plus patio seating on Pearl Street.

data.location: 250 Palm Coast Pkwy NE #403, Palm Coast, FL 32137
data.short_description: Mayday Handcrafted Ice Cream is coming to Suite 403 in Palm Coast, owned by Anne Patala. The St. Augustine-based brand makes small-batch ice cream and fresh waffle cones. It also has shops in St. Augustine, Jacksonville, Lakeland and Tampa's Ybor City.
Mayday is planning a shop at Hamlin in Winter Garden as part of its growth across Florida. No address or date is given.
Mayday is also planning a move into Naples. No address or date is given.
Aladdin's Eatery's newest Westerville restaurant has opened in the former MiaMar Grill space. The Lebanese-American chain has operated in the Columbus area since 1997.

data.location: 1607 N High St, Columbus, OH 43201, USA
data.short_description: Aladdin's is preparing to open a sixth Columbus-area location in the Gateway-University District near The Ohio State University. Dine-in, takeout, delivery and catering are planned. No exact opening date has been announced.

data.location: Dolphin Mall, 11401 NW 12th St., Suite E504, Miami, FL 33172
data.short_description: Seoul Meat Co, a Korean barbecue restaurant run by ICC Hospitality (CEO Julius Son), is coming to Dolphin Mall. State business records show the restaurant is in the works at the mall. Guests grill their own meat at tables equipped with built-in grills.
A Seoul Meat Co Korean Barbecue is listed as coming soon at Fashion Fair in Fresno. No address or date is given.

data.status: was expected to open in fall 2026
data.short_description: Chef Jeffrey Harris is bringing back his New Orleans-inspired restaurant Jimmie Lou's in the former Razzo space in Pendleton. The restaurant held a preview pop-up at the new location in September. An exact grand-opening date and full menu have not been confirmed.
Jimmie Lou's first launched in 2021 inside Oakley Kitchen Food Hall. It closed in 2022 as the food hall struggled.

data.location: Orlando and Tampa, Florida (Address not specified)
data.status: gearing up for major expansion; signed a 36-unit development agreement
data.short_description: Mike's Red Tacos signed a 36-unit development agreement with franchise group Built Better Brands, led by CEO Kal Gullapalli. The deal will grow the birria taco chain's presence across Orlando and Tampa. The brand began as a food truck in 2021 and opened its first brick-and-mortar location in San Diego in 2022.

data.status: will open sometime later this fall; construction is underway
data.short_description: Archer's Book Lounge is set to be a three-story cocktail bar, coffee shop and bookstore in downtown Monroe. Owners Joel and Alaina Williamson report progress on the second and third floors, with bookcases being delivered. The space will host reading groups and author nights.

data.store_name: Unnamed bar by Three Cherries Hospitality (TBA)
data.status: currently working through the permitting and licensing process
data.short_description: Three Cherries Hospitality will open a game-day-focused bar in the former La Linea space, according to a liquor license application to Community Board 3. Plans include eight TVs, a custom 16-seat bar and nine tables. It will operate daily from 3 p.m. to 4 a.m. once open.

DiAnoche, owned by Amber Arthur, will serve Mexican-inspired coffee by day and become an agave-focused bar at night. It will be the second location for the concept. The space will connect with London Road Pub.

data.location: Connected to the DiAnoche space at 3 London Road, Asheville
data.short_description: London Road Pub is a second location for Arthur's Olde London Road bar and will connect with the DiAnoche space. Arthur said the focus is on building out the two bar projects ahead of the new year.

data.status: pursuing a location; looking to open the location around fall 2027
data.short_description: Franchisee Stacked Hospitality is pursuing a Smalls Sliders location in the Vero Beach area after signing a four-unit lease deal for Florida's East Coast. CEO Joe Sloboda said the team is also looking at Fort Lauderdale/Wilton Manors, Coral Springs, Pompano and Port St. Lucie. Two locations will likely be open by November 2027, and addresses are being finalized.

Snooze plans its first Pflugerville restaurant, according to a TDLR project filing. The build-out is estimated at $1.2 million, with construction scheduled from January 15, 2027, to May 28. CEO Josh Kern said the restaurant will open in June 2027.

data.location: 100 E Hinckley Ave., Ridley Park, PA 19078
data.status: construction expected to begin next week
data.short_description: Magee Hospitality Group is developing a new concept in the former The Gas Light space; the name is still being finalized. Founder Joe Magee plans Italian-American cuisine with seafood and steaks. The space will undergo a complete buildout with an industrial design.

data.short_description: A permit filing dated October 15, 2026, lists a proposed Field of Greens restaurant as under review. The filing does not confirm construction has begun or give a target opening date. The concept serves salads, bowls, wraps, sandwiches, smoothies and acai bowls.

data.location: Near Yonge and Dundas, downtown Toronto (exact address not confirmed)
data.status: preparing to expand; new location planned
data.short_description: Mississauga-based Ketkoot, an Iraqi-style chargrilled chicken restaurant, is planning a downtown Toronto location near Yonge and Dundas. The exact address and opening date have not been confirmed. It currently operates at 3450 Platinum Drive, Unit 11, in Ridgeway Plaza.
The brand has indicated that a Vaughan location is in the works. Further Greater Toronto Area expansion is also planned.

data.location: 12794 West Forest Hill Blvd, Suite 5B, Wellington, FL 33414, USA
data.short_description: A commercial permit record dated October 15, 2026, shows Middle Ground Coffeehouse LLC's project in plan review. The filing does not show whether construction has started. No opening date or menu details have been announced.

data.location: Jacksonville, Gainesville, Tampa and Orlando, Florida (Address not specified)
data.status: preparing to make its Florida debut; 52-restaurant development agreement
data.short_description: Hawaiian Bros signed a 52-restaurant development agreement with Southern Rock Restaurants, LLC and Southern Rock Hawaii, LLC for Jacksonville, Gainesville, Tampa and Orlando. The partners are targeting 24 restaurants in the first three years of a six-year schedule. Southern Rock CEO Max Piet will lead the expansion.

A TDLR filing (project TABS2027003968) shows a new 7 Brew drive-thru stand estimated at $500,000. Construction is scheduled to begin January 4, 2027, and finish March 16, 2027. The filing names Southern Brew Corp as tenant and does not confirm an opening date.
